incident-bot: ALERT: Realtime p99 latency > 1.2s for /v1/generate (hosted-prod) — triggered 1750012345. Paging @oncall. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/example/p95p99
anna (oncall): I’m on it. any idea if customers affected or just internal noise? :pager:
incident-bot: Current empirical impact: 12% of requests >= p99 threshold, error rate steady, streaming stall count up +6m. Possible regression flagged by anomaly-detector v2.
mike (sre): Looking. quick checks: p95 jumped from ~180ms to ~420ms over the last 6m; p99 up to ~1.4s. No spike in 5xx overall but streaming session timeouts increase. link: https://grafana.redwood/d/realtime/latency?orgId=1
liz (infra): Checking node metrics. GPU pool for hosted-prod at 98% utilization on us-west-2a. Kube autoscaler didn't add new nodes — hitting account instance quota. Pod restarts minimal. No recent deploys in the last 30m per deploy-bot.
priya (eng-runtime): Noting that the model variant in prod was rolled 3h ago to quantized v2. Could be slower at tail for longer prompts. Also batching queues show more head-of-line wait time in the router.
anna (oncall): Ok quick TODOs: 1) Mike check request distribution (regions, routes). 2) Liz confirm autoscale/quotas. 3) Priya suggest immediate mitigations we can toggle. I'll page the escalation if customers impacted.
mike (sre): regional breakdown: 78% of the increased p99 from us-west; negligible from eu-west. Top endpoint is streaming chat with long-context (avg tokens > 1k).
liz (infra): Confirmed quota hit on us-west capacity pool. Raising request to infra-ops to bump; ETA 12-15m. Meanwhile we can free up capacity by draining non-critical dedicated pools.
priya (eng-runtime): Fast mitigations we can apply now (non-disruptive):
- disable large batch windows for /v1/generate (set max_batch_size=1)
- enable model fallback routing to the low-latency variant `rw-compact-v1` for hosted-prod (route-level override)
- reduce streaming chunk timeout from 10s -> 3s (short-term)
Example quick command to set route override:
```
redwoodctl route update --route /v1/generate --override "fallback_model=rw-compact-v1,max_batch_size=1"
```
This is reversible immediately.
anna (oncall): Good. Priya, do we have confidence rw-compact-v1 preserves quality for current prod prompts?
priya (eng-runtime): For most short/medium prompts yes. For long-context streaming it's slightly lower quality but still within acceptable thresholds for mitigation. We should prefer this to customer-visible timeouts.
mike (sre): I'm happy to flip the override if Liz can confirm that switching will actually reduce queueing pressure rather than just moving it.
liz (infra): If fallback reduces GPU memory per model, we will free nodes. I still want to drain non-critical pools concurrently. Starting drain on `dedicated-nonprod` now.
jon (pm): Heads-up: I’ll draft a short customer note if we flip to fallback. Need a single-sentence impact summary and ETA.
anna (oncall): Mike, flip the route override when ready. Priya, prepare rollback steps. Jon, standby to send brief comms when we confirm drop in p99.
mike (sre): Applying override now. `redwoodctl` returned success. Pushing change...
incident-bot: ACTION: route update applied by mike (sre) at 1750012389.
priya (eng-runtime): Observability: within 60s we should see backlog reduce. Rolling metrics: p95 -> 320ms, p99 -> 700ms (prelim). Streaming stalls down, chunk latency improved.
anna (oncall): Nice. Monitor for 10m. Liz keep pushing on quota and node additions.
liz (infra): Infra-ops accepted capacity increase request; new nodes provisioning ETA ~10m.
mike (sre): p99 trending back toward baseline (currently ~450ms). No increase in error rate.
jon (pm): Draft customer blurb: "We detected elevated latency affecting streaming endpoints in US-West and temporarily routed to a lower-latency model to restore responsiveness. Your requests may see minor quality differences; full model restored once capacity stabilizes." Good?
anna (oncall): Yep. Send once we confirm stable for 10m. Also create a follow-up ticket to evaluate why autoscaler didn't trigger (include quota scenario).
priya (eng-runtime): Rollback plan: remove route override and restore `max_batch_size=64` when GPU pool utilization < 70% for 5m. Command:
```
redwoodctl route update --route /v1/generate --override ""
```
Keep me looped.
mike (sre): Logging a short incident note and assigning follow-up to eng-runtime + infra.
anna (oncall): Closing the active page for now — all hands keep watching. I'll hand this to oncall followup rotation. Final status in 10m. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Severity set to SEV3. Incident thread created: https://incidents.redwood/1750012345
anna (oncall): follow-up owners: priy a, liz infra, mike sre, jon pm. Postmortem if we see recurrence.
jon (pm): I'll prepare a short status update for customers if it persists.
anna (oncall): Thanks everyone. Leaving monitoring window open.
